description:
DESIGN (Fable, s493, 2026-09-20).  The scratch prototype is ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/bin/diffrun.pl + mkvariants.pl + corpus/cmpvar.pl; the seed corpus is ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/corpus/orig/ (122 programs: s491 idioms 42, s492 battery2 33, s492 modwork 28, s493 perlfunc index 19; today 77 identical on main 5316d666).

1. CORPUS, checked in under `everyday/`: `<area>/<name>.pl` + `<name>.expect` (perl 5.40.3 STDOUT, bytes) + optional `<name>.rc` (default 0), `<name>.stdin`, and header comments `# args: ...`, `# needs: Module::Name` (skipped, and SAID so, when perl itself lacks the module), `# nondeterministic-ok` is NOT a thing: a program whose output varies is not admitted.  Areas: idioms/ io/ modules/ index/ (the perlfunc-perlvar-perlop-perlre-perlrun walk, #2093) oneliners/.  Every program is OURS -> `tools/tag-license`; third-party text (perl1line.txt) is NOT checked in -- fetched on demand into scratch, or re-typed as our own programs.
2. RUNNER `tools/everyday-smoke.pl [--jobs N] [--timeout S] [AREA|FILE...]`: runs each program under `./pcl` (NOT runpcl: script arguments must pass; `< stdin-file or /dev/null`), compares STDOUT bytes + exit status with the checked-in expectation -- so a run needs NO perl and is reproducible; keeps PCL's stderr beside the result (`.everyday/<name>.{out,err,rc}`), prints one line per NON-identical program with pcl's first complaint, then `N of M everyday programs identical to perl`.  SBCL is spawned through tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm like every runner (it goes through `pcl`, so it is).
3. BASELINE `baselines/everyday-baseline.tsv` (name, verdict same|DIFF|RC|TIMEOUT, cause = task number or not-supported.md anchor): the run ends with NEW (was same, now differs => exit 1) / FIXED (edit the row out) / UNEXPLAINED (a DIFF row with no cause => exit 1).  Rows leave BY EDIT, never by re-bless.  A DIFF whose cause is a ruled non-support cites the section.
4. `--verify-with-perl`: re-derives every `.expect` with the local perl and reports DRIFT (an expectation that perl no longer produces is an invalid probe -- fix the program, not the expectation); `--bless-expect FILE` writes one.  Run it when adding programs and at a perl upgrade.
5. `--variants dp,dpp,sub,block,eval,pkg,strict` (needs perl): generates perl-VALIDATED mutations on the fly (B::Deparse / Deparse -p re-spelling; body wrapped in a sub, a bare block, a string eval, another package; strict+warnings added) and reports programs whose PCL verdict CHANGES against their as-written run.  s493 measured on the seed corpus: block 0, strict 0, pkg 0, sub 1, eval 14 (7 = the ruled multi-package refusal), dp 21, dpp 25 -- see #2096, #2091, #1192.
6. WHEN: once per round, before a tag, and after any `lib/**` shim change (add the row to CLAUDE.md's WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN table -- Fable edits CLAUDE.md, put the row in the report).  ~3 min at --jobs 2 for 122 programs.
7. NOT IN SCOPE: fixing what it finds (each DIFF is a task); the scaling battery (#2098) is a sibling instrument `tools/everyday-scaling.pl` -- same batch if cheap: run scaling.pl under pcl, flag any row whose 4N/N ratio exceeds 8, exit 1 on a flagged row not in a small allow-list.
Bar: tools/t/everyday-smoke.t (run directly, like tools/t/tap-align.t) driving the runner over a 3-program fixture corpus incl. a DIFF, an RC and a `# needs:` skip; `Pl/t/license-tag-01.t` green; docs/everyday-battery.md (what it is, what it is NOT: "68 of 103" was never a compatibility percentage -- the programs cover ground, they are not a sample); README/STATUS wording is the USER's.


=== BRIEF READY (s495, 2026-09-21, Fable) ===
~/pcl-agent-scratch/s495/s495e/prompt.md (label s495e, IDs 2285-2339, NO generation string: a tool batch).  The brief NARROWS the design: IN = runner + corpus (the 122 seed programs, admitted under perl by a three-run determinism test incl. a copy under another path) + baseline with a first-diff-line column and five buckets (NEW / FIXED / MOVED / UNEXPLAINED / STALE; rows leave BY EDIT, no bless option) + `--record` appending baselines/everyday-history.tsv (the batch-by-batch trend; M in every row) + `--corpus DIR --baseline FILE` so the Rosetta population (#2104) uses the same tool + tools/t/everyday-smoke.t driven by a FAKE pcl (no SBCL, no dependence on a live PCL bug) + docs/everyday-battery.md.  OUT (stays here as residue): --variants (item 5), the scaling instrument (item 7 -> #2098's batch), one-liners as an area, battery 3, CI.  USER directive (end of s494): this number is what the project steers by; goal > 90 %.  Launch in the FIRST free slot, ahead of s494k.

=== DONE (s495e, 2026-09-21, Opus) ===
SHIPPED on main 87e4e4b3, four commits, nothing under Pl/ cl/ lib/:
  tools/everyday-smoke.pl          the runner (core modules only; PCLPaths::root)
  everyday/<area>/<name>.pl        122 programs + .expect (+1 .rc), all licence-tagged
  baselines/everyday-baseline.tsv  37 rows, every one attributed
  tools/t/everyday-smoke.t         59 rows, a FAKE pcl, no SBCL, ~42 s (run directly)
  tools/t/everyday-fixture/, tools/t/everyday-admit/   its two fixture corpora
  docs/everyday-battery.md         the manual
  tools/lib/PCLLicense.pm          `everyday` added to @ROOTS (the gate row gains 1)
  .gitignore                       /.everyday/

FIRST MEASUREMENT: EVERYDAY: 85 of 122 identical to perl (69.7 %) -- 98313c26 gen v2-1740
  idioms 38/42, index 10/19, modules 14/28, programs 23/33.
  1 m 49 s cold at --jobs 2, 18 s warm.  122 of 122 programs ADMITTED (three perl
  runs incl. a copy under another absolute path); two repaired first, each saying
  so in its own header: idioms/list-util printed a _Pair ADDRESS, programs/env-exit-end
  stripped $0's directory with a substitution keyed on the OLD file name.
  STABILITY: four whole-corpus runs (3 x --jobs 2, 1 x --jobs 1) = identical verdicts
  and identical first-diff lines for all 122; zero unstable.

DESIGN CHANGES against items 1-7 above (the s495e brief narrowed them; where they
differ the shipped behaviour is what stands):
  * the baseline gained a FIRST-DIFF-LINE column and two more buckets, MOVED and
    STALE, and there is deliberately NO --bless-baseline (rows leave by edit).
  * --record appends baselines/everyday-history.tsv; refused for a subset, a
    non-default corpus or a dirty tree.
  * --corpus DIR / --baseline FILE make another population use the same tool;
    proved on a 10-program Rosetta scratch copy (10 of 10), which is #2104's shape.
  * the test drives a FAKE pcl (tools/t/everyday-fixture/fake-pcl) instead of the
    real one: every verdict reachable in seconds, and the test cannot rot when a
    real PCL bug is fixed.
  * areas are idioms/ programs/ modules/ index/ (item 1's io/ and oneliners/ do
    not exist; `# nondeterministic-ok` was never a thing and still is not).

FILED while attributing the baseline: #2285 (a `package NAME;` inside a
string-eval'd sub loses the captured lexicals -- core Benchmark::timeit is dead),
#2286 (List::Util::pairs unblessed + COUNT in scalar context), #2287 (File::Copy's
forward goto lowers to a bare (go :tag) -- an SBCL compiled-program-error).

RESIDUE, still this task's:
  * item 5 --variants (B::Deparse / -p re-spelling, body in a sub / bare block /
    string eval / another package / +strict): measured in s493, not built.
  * item 7 the scaling battery: #2098's batch owns it.
  * an `oneliners/` area: needs #2097 (pcl has no -n -p -l -a -F -i -0).
  * battery 3 (the candidate list is in ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s491/probes/central/WRITEUP.md).
  * CI, and a row in the Pl/t gate: deliberately not done -- a run costs minutes.
  * README / STATUS wording is the USER's (s495e proposed a sentence in its report).


=== MERGED s495 (Fable, 2026-09-21) ===
main = ba30b0f7 (ff of f9011ec6 + one Fable review commit: STALE asks the disk, three `unless` re-spelled, CLAUDE.md row + steering paragraph; COMMON.md gained the standing paragraph).  FIRST NUMBER: EVERYDAY 85 of 122 identical to perl (69.7 %) -- idioms 38/42, index 10/19, modules 14/28, programs 23/33; reproduced by Fable on the sha; test 59/59; gate 257/8588.  STEERING TABLE at the merge (cause -> programs): #2093 missing builtins 5; #2084 module edges 3; #155 tie ARRAY/HASH 2; #2002 2; #2007 2; #2081 2; NS XS 2; 19 singletons.  s492c (in flight) holds ~8 rows.  THE TASK STAYS OPEN FOR ITS RESIDUE ONLY: `--variants` (item 5), the scaling instrument (item 7 -> #2098's batch), an `oneliners/` area (needs #2097), battery 3 (NEW programs -- the corpus must GROW toward what ordinary scripts do, or 90 % of 122 becomes the goal instead of 90 % of everyday Perl), CI.  Snag recorded: `--record` refuses a dirty tree and main's checkout always carries the USER's README edit -> the merging agent records from its clean worktree.
subject: DONE s495 but for its RESIDUE (variants, scaling, one-liners area, battery 3): INSTRUMENT (USER-APPROVED s493: "Yes, run on demand"): `tools/everyday-smoke.pl` + a checked-in corpus of ordinary programs with perl's expected output -- "N of M everyday programs identical to perl", with a blessed per-program baseline like the sweep's; NOT in the Pl/t gate, NOT in CI
